Quillwend sync API — limits
Owner: Tomas · Updated 2026-09-09

Per device: 120 requests per minute.
Per account: 600 requests per minute across all devices.
Maximum payload per request: 256 KB.
Maximum events per push: 500.

A request over a limit gets HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header in seconds. The apps back off
exponentially, starting at 2 seconds and capping at 5 minutes.
